selection: Purposive bounded upstream originals: six existing-language runtime regressions, twenty candidate family representatives and interaction/root checks. This matrix is an execution sample, not exhaustive coverage or a feature acceptance tally.
limitations: Unknown directives, unimplemented helpers, diagnostic equivalence, unsupported compiler settings, mixed cyclic Java/Kotlin compilation, and incremental edit scenarios are harness_unsupported.
Compilation/signature-only cases are scoped explicitly and do not establish runtime behavior or Kotlin metadata compatibility.
Incremental input is inventoried only; no speedup or rebuild-correctness claim.

Primitive array, sealed, value, generic, suspend and other family representatives do not establish every family dimension. Family acceptance requires additional independent assertions, invalid cases and official consumers.
